name: Carbon impact evaluator
description: Estimates and displays the CO2 footprint (per byte and per visit) of the site's node pages using the Green Web Foundation CO2.js library.
project_description: The Carbon Impact Evaluator module estimates the carbon emissions associated with a website's node pages. It uses the CO2.js library from the Green Web Foundation, which offers two calculation methodologies: Sustainable Web Design (SWD, exposed as 'Per Visit'), which uses data transfer as a proxy for energy consumption and factors in first/return visit ratios and datacenter grid intensity; and OneByte (exposed as 'Per Byte'), which derives CO2 per byte transferred. Administrators choose one or both models in the settings form, flag whether the site is on a green host, and (for the SWD model) provide the ISO alpha-3 country code of the datacenter. A block renders a floating badge on node pages; client-side JavaScript measures the page transfer size via the browser Performance API, computes the footprint with CO2.js, colour-codes it on an A+ to F scale, and posts the results back to the module. Per-node visit counts and the last computed per-byte/per-visit values are stored in a custom co2_info table, and an admin summary table is available at /carbon-impact-evaluator/table.
